files.description: Main EHI Tables Export landing page describing the export format (TSV), scope, and linking to the data dictionary and download.
EHI Export Schema index page listing all 7,672 tables with links to individual table documentation. Contains the complete table listing organized alphabetically (A-W).

ZIP archive containing 7,672 individual HTML files, each documenting one EHI export table with description, primary key, and column definitions (name, type, discontinued status, description). Also includes a CSS stylesheet and _index.htm. Filename from Content-Disposition: 'Epic EHI Tables.zip'. Generated 2026-02-15.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses all 7,672 .htm files from the extracted ZIP into structured JSON using cheerio.

Complete structured extraction of all 7,672 EHI tables and 63,121 columns. Each entry contains table_name, description, primary_key, and columns array with ordinal, name, type, discontinued flag, and description.
Parsing statistics: 7,672 tables parsed with 0 failures, 63,121 columns, 100% description coverage, column type distribution.
Enrichment documentation with run commands, input boundary, output format, and known parsing limitations.
